messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert — eu-central2 GPU pool: 12 node terminations in last 9m, available capacity down ~58%. Autoscaler hitting cloud quota errors. https://internal.monitoring/graph/abc
alex: Oncall here. Confirmed. Seeing elevated pod OOM/eviction + failed node provisioning. Priority: protect customer latency. Proposing temporary per-tenant backpressure + route low-priority traffic to us-west1.
sara: +1. Need to apply caps quickly. I'll push an emergency rate-limit policy. Using rw-admin CLI to set per-tenant caps for region eu-central2.
pranav: How aggressive? We should avoid killing interactive sessions. Maybe cap token-rate rather than concurrent connections.
sara: Plan: default 30 tk/s, heavy customers 10 tk/s, api-surface 'streaming' 15 tk/s. Execute now.
alex: If someone can run command, do it. I'll prepare routing change to prefer us-west1 for non-SLA tenants.
emily: Heads up: two large customers (tenant-acme, tenant-mono) will be impacted. Support notified.
pranav: Command ready:
```
rw-admin set-rate-policy --scope region:eu-central2 --policy per_tenant \
  --default-rate 30 --heavy-rate 10 --streaming-rate 15 --duration 20m
```
sara: Running it now...
sara: Done. Policy ID rp-202603-ec2 applied. Verifying token counts.
ops-bot: Policy rp-202603-ec2 activated at 1769994390; metric filter engaged.
alex: Rolling routing adjustment: prefer-region=us-west1 for tenants without pinned-region. Pushing canary now.
pranav: Canary routing OK for 5% traffic. Latency for routed users +12ms, cost delta +8%. CPU/GPU pressure in eu-central2 reduced ~22%.
emily: Support updated status page: "Degraded capacity in eu-central2. Temporary per-customer rate limits applied; some traffic routed to us-west1." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1769994321
support-bot: Notifying tenant-acme and tenant-mono via escalation list.
alex: Monitoring: error budget burn slowing. Need to keep limits until autoscaler quota error fixed. Assigning follow-ups: @sara to validate autoscaler quota; @pranav to run soak in staging; @emily to own comms.
sara: Filing infra ticket for quota bump with cloud provider and autoscaler fix doc: https://internal/infra/tickets/INC-3129
pranav: Running a short soak test against rp-202603-ec2 policy.
ops-bot: eu-central2 available GPU nodes back up to +40% at 1769994680. Evictions dropping.
alex: Gradually relaxing limits in 10m windows. Relax default->50 then remove if stable.
sara: Will coordinate rollback. Good job team. Postmortem plan: include autoscaler quota guard, emergency-runbook tweaks, customer throttling playbook.
emily: I'll draft the incident summary and customer impact notes after we fully recover.
ops-bot: Incident state: mitigated. Remaining action items tracked in INC-3129.
